storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard; keep away from steam. Refrigerating after opening keeps the aroma longer.
looksLike: A coarse, brick-red to orange-brown ground blend with a roasted, curry-leaf and fenugreek smell, sold in 100 g and 200 g pouches.
howToPick: Look for a coarse, even, reddish-brown powder that smells of roasted coriander, fenugreek and curry leaf; avoid pale, clumped or musty packs. Check the label for added flour or starch if you need gluten-free.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack (general guidance; check the best-before). (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)
substitutes: Homemade mix (coriander powder + red chilli powder + a pinch of fenugreek, cumin and hing)
Bisi bele bath or kuzhambu powder
Rasam powder or homemade roasted blend
Coriander powder + red chilli powder + a pinch of fenugreek and turmeric
